layers.name: bit reversal
layers.formula: T2(m)_i = m_{L+1-i} if beta=1 else m_i

layers.name: keyed block scrambling
layers.formula: partition into ceil(L/B) blocks; permute blocks by pi ~ FisherYates(KS_K('blk')); rotate block j left by rho_{pi(j)} = KS_K('rot'||j) mod B

parameters.pi, rho: derived from secret key K, never transmitted

layers.role: security layer: destroys local payload structure

layers.name: keyed diffusion
layers.formula: s_i = t_i XOR s_{i-1} XOR k_i,  k = KS_K('dif', L)

parameters.k, IV: derived from secret key K, never transmitted

layers.role: security layer: makes the embedded stream computationally indistinguishable from uniform, so payload-statistics attacks (chi-square, pairs-of-values) gain no advantage

layers.name: segmentation
layers.role: each segment gets an independent GA-optimised theta
